domains.name: Discovery Pattern Design
objectives: Operations (Match, Parse variable, Parse file, Parsing strategies) – Syntax (Variables, Attributes, Regex)
Application Identification and Connection Sections (Patterns, Identification and Connection Sections, Troubleshooting)

domains.name: Discovery Configuration
objectives: Discovery Setup (Behaviors, Clusters, IP Services, Schedules)
Discovery Process Flow (PCIE Phases, ECC Queue, Status, Discovered Device)

domains.name: Configuration Management Database
objectives: CI Class Manager (CMDB Health Dashboard, CI Class Manager, CMDB Tables, Reclassification, CMDB Relationships)
CMDB Identification and Reconciliation (CI Identifiers, Reconciliation Definitions, Data source Precedence, CMDB De-duplication)

domains.name: Discovery Engagement Readiness
objectives: Operationalizing IT (MID Server and Discovery Dashboards, Benefits)

exam_rules: No notes, books, or external resources. Closed-book exam. ServiceNow platform access not provided during exam. Proctor monitors via webcam.
id_requirements: One valid, government-issued photo ID with full name and photo. Name must match exactly as registered.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-19: ServiceNow University's 'Certified Implementation Specialist - Discovery (CIS-DISCO) Mainline Exam Blueprint' (KB0011545, 'Updated November 2025') says 'The Certified Implementation Specialist – Discovery exam confirms you have the knowledge and skills to configure, implement, and maintain the ServiceNow Discovery application.', 'The exam duration is 90 minutes. Number of Items The exam consists of 45 questions.' and 'Candidates must hold the Certified Implementation Specialist – Data Foundations (CMDB and CSDM) Certification before registering for this exam.'; the exam's LXP listing reads 'Certified Implementation Specialist - Discovery (CIS-DISCO) EXAM : PEARSON VUE 1 HOUR 30 MINUTES Need To Register'.

official_study_resources.notes: Official ServiceNow University platform with courses aligned to each credential
official_study_resources.title: ServiceNow Training & Certification Portal

passing_score_scale: Scaled score; the cut score is not publicly disclosed and is not always 70%.
renewal_options: Pass a delta maintenance exam after each major ServiceNow release (approximately twice per year). Delta exams are shorter and free for certified candidates.

retake_policy.notes: 7-day waiting period after first failed attempt. Full exam fee required for retake. Certifications must be maintained via delta exams after each major release.
